I implemented `minidb/parser.py`, and all 33 tests in `tests/test_parser.py` pass. I didn't run any other test files.

I didn't change `tests/test_parser.py`. It builds its tokens by hand, so it never calls the tokenizer stub.

The parser is a small private `_Parser` class that holds the token list and position. `parse`, `parse_script` and `parse_expression` each build one and call its statement or expression methods.

If a token list doesn't end with an EOF token, the parser adds one rather than raising an error.
